trip.title: Canadian Rockies Overland
trip.notes: 12-day round trip framework. All day titles, routes, and stops below are placeholders for planning and must be researched and verified before use in the field.

days.title: Day 1 — Denver, CO to Pelham Lake, WY (via Dubois)
days.summary: Primary dispersed-camping scouting target: Pelham Lake, reached via Dubois on US-26/287 and Forest Road 540 (the legal mapped approach). First backup: Brooks Lake. Reserve: Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs. Union Pass has been removed from the plan entirely. ~452 mi / ~9h09m driving. Legally-researched dispersed-camping search areas (300-ft MVUM corridors) remain drawn for Brooks Lake and Sheridan Creek/Warm Springs; Pelham Lake's exact coordinate is a preliminary scouting marker only, not yet legally verified or field-confirmed.
